<section name="Agent Memory" source="memories" priority="2">
<document source="session-summary/2026-10-23-loop-pr-upkeep-auto-merge-no-fixer" type="memory" tokens="506">
**session-summary/2026-10-23-loop-pr-upkeep-auto-merge-no-fixer** (memory): PR re-cinq/lore#3376 (2026-10-23): the implementation loop keeps its pull requests mergeable on GitHub events; auto merge fixes nothing.

DECISIONS (user): auto-merge must not fix anything — `auto-merge-fix`, `fix-pr`, `fix-replies` deleted, `decideMergeReady` answers ready|wait only; a loop PR is the loop's to rebase/repair, a person's PR is the person's. Rebase whenever a loop PR is behind main, not only when red.

DESIGN: `await-pr` (decidePrReady) reads `mergeable` + `behindBy` (prBehindBy dep = repo.branchBehindBy, the same count loop-sync-check reads) BEFORE CI → `pr_conflicting`/`pr_behind` → changes_requested → sync-pr; sync edges iteration_max 6, fix stays 3. A settled loop PR that is behind/conflicted/red gets an UPKEEP RUN: the same implementation-loop line started with floor-client `lines.start(..., {entry: "sync-pr"})`, keyed on `backlog: upkeep-<pr>` so it never joins or holds `backlog:tickets`; start items task_id (taskQueue.latestLoopTaskByIssue) + ticket file (issue text) + pr_url. `apps/stations/src/events/loop-upkeep-handlers.ts` answers github.push (default branch only) and github.check_suite.completed; an open run on the branch → judgeFloorPullRequest (floor-ci-wait `only` filter) instead of a start. run-settled settles upkeep runs like any loop run (settlingTasks CAS no-ops on the completed task).

BUG FIXED ON THE WAY: buildStationHandlers registered sweep events with Map.set, so two sweeps on one event overwrote each other (blocked-reason already declared both events); now addHandlers composes.

LINT TRAPS: `events` layer may not import @re-cinq/floor-client (use LoopRunsFloor from shared); max-member-chain 2 hops; no-flag-params; max-lines-per-function 20; file max 300 (split pr-ready-check/sweep-reads.ts). `eslint --fix specs adrs` repoints anchors by test title but NOT short-label links like `[validated by pending waits]` — those need hand repointing. Shipped agent count test went 33→32.
</document>
<document source="session:re-cinq/lore" type="episode" tokens="121">
**session:re-cinq/lore** (episode) [observed]: The auto-merge loop is designed to merge passed pull requests on protected branches.

**session:re-cinq/lore** (episode) [observed]: A pull request whose auto-merge run already settled on its current head commit stays armed or parked instead of starting a new run every 5 minutes until a new commit is pushed

**session:re-cinq/lore** (episode) [observed]: The pull request workflow has been streamlined with native auto-merge support.
</document>
<document source="manual:28c28451-d416-4b50-af74-2e31b1a83870" type="episode" tokens="38">
**manual:28c28451-d416-4b50-af74-2e31b1a83870** (episode) [observed]: The auto-merge system had grown to include auto-merge-fix to cover PR watching.
</document>
</section>
